mtr_options.description: Default options string passed via MTR_OPTIONS env var. Overrides are handled by explicit flags below.

target_host.description: The destination hostname or IP address to trace.

protocol.description: Protocol to use for probes: icmp, udp, tcp, or sctp.

interface.description: Network interface name to send probes from (e.g., eth0). Leave empty for default route.

local_port.description: Source port number for UDP traces. Only used if protocol is udp. 0 means auto-select.

packet_size.description: Packet size in bytes for ICMP/TCP/UDP probes.

report_cycles.description: Number of cycles (seconds) to run in report mode.

interval_seconds.description: Interval in seconds between probe packets.

max_ttl.description: Maximum number of hops (TTL) to trace.

display_mode.description: Initial display mode: 0 (statistics), 1 (stripchart no latency), 2 (stripchart with latency).
